name: Daraku no Kuni no Angie ~Kyoukai no Mesu Dorei-tachi~
original_name: 堕落の国のアンジー ～狂界の牝奴隷達～
source:
Did you read "Alice in Wonderland" written by Lewis Carroll?
If not, then this alternative version of events for you.
The game tells about two girls named Angie and Ruby, who fell down the rabbit hole and ended up 
in Wonderland (The Decadence-land) populated by peculiar, anthropomorphic creatures.
